brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail as a new original raster illustration. Landscape 16:9, target 1792×1024 or 1920×1080, at least 1000 pixels wide. Opaque PNG.
Approved visual direction: nearly black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, off-white typography, expressive hand-drawn ink strokes and dry brush texture. Few large elements, very bold Japanese type, polished sports editorial composition.
Subject: Kerry Blackshear Jr., as a clearly hand-drawn ink illustration, NOT photographic. I have visually checked his official Gunma club profile photo for appearance: very short close-cropped black hair with a low rounded hairline, strong broad but slightly elongated face, full lips, broad straight nose, thick expressive eyebrows, deep-set dark eyes, short neatly edged full jaw/chin beard connected to sideburns and a thinner moustache, muscular broad shoulders and substantial athletic build. Preserve these observed features. Do not draw the curly tall hair or slender face of the unrelated approved style-reference player. Use off-white/black crosshatching and visible brush marks, with enough face highlights to recognize him.
Composition: left 61 percent reserved for the text hierarchy; right 39 percent a waist-up illustration of this player in a simple ready-to-pass pose holding ONE orange basketball at lower chest height. Both hands are anatomically plausible, five fingers per hand, partially occluded naturally by the ball. Head and ball fully inside the frame with generous margins. Plain dark sleeveless basketball jersey with a little lime trim, absolutely no logos, sponsor text, team insignia or jersey number. No other players. A diagonal lime ink brush stroke behind the player creates energy while keeping the typography clear. This is a symbolic illustration based on listed performance, not a specific actual moment or decisive shot.
Text EXACTLY as below; no additional text. Keep every line comfortably inside the image. Highly legible Japanese lettering with accurate punctuation and digits:
Small top left brand: "バスケまとめ"
Below brand: "2026.10.26｜B.PREMIER"
Large off-white heading: "貢献度1位"
Main largest line, with lime numerals: "EFF 46"
Clear medium name line: "ブラックシアー・ジュニア"
Supporting line: "群馬｜20得点・15リバウンド・6アシスト"
Small but legible qualifier near bottom: "公式記録の訂正により変更の場合あり"
Footer labels, fully readable: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "成績をもとにしたイメージ"
The displayed ranking is only the contribution/EFF ranking for games on October 26, 2026, not season ranking, scoring rank, an award or a record. EFF 46 is NOT 46 points. Keep "EFF" directly attached to the large 46; the actual points scored are 20. All displayed article facts are exclusively from the supplied fixed source.html/source.txt. Do not add victory scores, claims about nationality, MVP, records, a trophy, or other claims.
Strong mobile thumbnail readability; safe margins at least 4 percent. Footer must remain legible, not tiny or clipped. Avoid photorealism, logos, clutter, illegible text, extra fingers, cropped head or ball.
